name: birta-writer
description: Obsidian-friendly visual Markdown editor with broad support for wikilinks, callouts, tables, Mermaid, LaTeX, and rich web embeds.

languageModelTools.name: birta_getEditorContext
languageModelTools.userDescription: The file, caret, and selection active in the Birta Writer markdown editor
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the file path, caret position, and selected text of the document the user currently has open in the Birta Writer markdown editor. Use this whenever the user refers to their current file, what they have open, or their selection in the markdown editor: VS Code's built-in active-editor APIs cannot see Birta's WYSIWYG editor, so this tool is the only way to read that context.

birta.fontFamilySans.default: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif

birta.toolbar.visible.description: Show the toolbar. When off, a small tab at the top edge (or the Toggle Toolbar command) brings it back.

birta.toolbar.items.codeBlock.description: Code block button: pick a toolbar zone or hide it.

birta.toolbar.items.horizontalRule.description: Horizontal rule button: pick a toolbar zone or hide it.

birta.toolbar.order.markdownDescription: Left-to-right ordering of toolbar items within their zone. List item ids in the order you want; within each zone, listed items come first (in this order), then any unlisted items in the built-in order. Ids: `format`, `clearFormatting`, `fontPreset`, `bold`, `italic`, `strikethrough`, `highlight`, `inlineCode`, `link`, `image`, `table`, `footnote`, `math`, `listMenu`, `quote`, `codeBlock`, `horizontalRule`, `viewSource`, `styleCheck`, `find`, `settings`, `toc`. Example: to put Clear Formatting last in a zone, list the other items in that zone before `clearFormatting`.

birta.floatingToolbar.enabled.description: Show a floating formatting palette above the current selection. For a text selection it offers inline formatting; for a whole-block (multi-block) selection it offers move, duplicate, and delete.

birta.floatingToolbar.items.format.description: Floating palette: show the text-level menu (paragraph, headings).

birta.floatingToolbar.items.bold.description: Floating palette: show the Bold button.

birta.floatingToolbar.items.italic.description: Floating palette: show the Italic button.

birta.floatingToolbar.items.strikethroug.description: Floating palette: show the Strikethrough button.

birta.floatingToolbar.items.inlineCode.description: Floating palette: show the Inline Code button.

birta.floatingToolbar.items.highlight.description: Floating palette: show the Highlight button.

birta.floatingToolbar.items.link.description: Floating palette: show the Insert/Edit Link button.

birta.floatingToolbar.items.sectionLink.description: Floating palette: show the Link to Section button (anchor link to a heading).

birta.floatingToolbar.items.clearFormatt.description: Floating palette: show the Clear Formatting button.

birta.floatingToolbar.items.agentReferen.description: Floating palette: show the Copy Reference for AI Agent button (copies a path#L12-L20 reference to the selection).

birta.embeds.providers.youtube.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show YouTube links as cards. A still facade until you click; the player frame is created only then. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave YouTube links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.vimeo.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Vimeo links as cards. A still facade until you click; the player frame is created only then. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Vimeo links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.loom.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Loom links as cards. A still facade until you click; the player frame is created only then. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Loom links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.figma.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Figma links as cards. Design, board, slides, deck and prototype links. A still facade until you click; the frame is created only then. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Figma links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.github.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show GitHub links as cards. Repository, file, pull-request and issue cards. Built from the link alone, so it needs no network and requests nothing. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave GitHub links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.googledrive.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Google Drive links as cards. A preview frame for a link-shared file, created only when you click. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Google Drive links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.googledocs.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Google Docs links as cards. A published-to-web document, framed only when you click. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Google Docs links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.googleslides.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Google Slides links as cards. A published-to-web deck, framed only when you click. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Google Slides links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.googlesheets.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Google Sheets links as cards. A published-to-web sheet, framed only when you click. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Google Sheets links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.googlefile.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Google edit links links as cards. Ordinary `/edit` links to Docs, Slides and Sheets, which Google refuses to let anyone frame. Shown as a card instead. Built from the link alone, so it needs no network and requests nothing. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Google edit links links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.miro.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Miro links as cards. A public board, framed for pan and zoom only when you click. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Miro links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.linear.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show Linear links as cards. Issue cards. Built from the link alone, so it needs no network and requests nothing. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave Linear links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.codepen.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show CodePen links as cards. A pen, framed only when you click. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave CodePen links looking like ordinary links.

birta.embeds.providers.codesandbox.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show CodeSandbox links as cards. A sandbox, framed only when you click. birta.embeds.providers.stackblitz.markdownDescription: **Display only — your file never changes.** Show StackBlitz links as cards. A project, framed only when you click. Requires `#birta.embeds.enabled#` and `#birta.network.enabled#`. Turn this off to leave StackBlitz links looking like ordinary links.

scripts.package: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('releases',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-dependencies --out releases/ --baseContentUrl https://github.com/harlanlewis/birta-writer/blob/main --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/harlanlewis/birta-writer/raw/main && node scripts/check-vsix.mjs
scripts.test:integration: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out',{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json && node out/test/runTest.js
